environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) in us-east-1. Pod runs with default service account. AWS IMDS v1 enabled on nodes (HttpTokens: optional). CoreDNS with default TTL caching (30s). No network policies applied to the namespace. SERVICE_CREDENTIAL and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN injected via environment variables from Secrets Manager with manual rotation. The internal-api service is exposed via ClusterIP with no egress restrictions.
